notes.title: Revelation
notes.notes:
We wanted to replicate the success of Banana, but we had no idea what truly made Banana successful.
After its release, we conducted in-depth research to understand how Banana generates revenue. We realized that the only way to monetize a similar concept would involve creating a kind of Ponzi scheme—manipulating the market by purchasing rare items from our own accounts to fabricate the illusion of high market activity. This approach would encourage users to farm items and trade them for profit. However, we concluded that this is not the path we want to take in game development.

We value creativity and strive for healthy, ethical game development practices.
Despite the challenges, we remain determined to continue our journey in game development. We're currently planning and prototyping a brand-new game with fresh ideas designed to capture your heart and soul. We sincerely hope you’ll continue to support us as we move forward!

The [i]Well Dumb[/i] project taught us the importance of releasing a polished product, and we’re incredibly grateful for your feedback.

A special thanks to the YouTubers who took the time to spotlight our game: [b]Free2Play Weekly[/b] ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4_B-qLHx1XE&t=951s]channel[/url]), [b]Gleb7000[/b] ([url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vzNYIIMsOKE]channel[/url])
